CLdN is a leading provider of integrated quay-to-quay and door-to-door logistics solutions. Founded in 1929, CLdN ensures reliable, cost-effective transport that links the major economic areas of Europe. With 30 ships and more than 200 sailings a week, CLdN provides shortsea connections between the European continent, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Iberia and Scandinavia and offers the lowest CO2 footprint of all Western European RoRo operators. CLdN’s cargo and multimodal services have a Europe-wide reach using CLdN’s extensive network of ships, terminals and equipment. CLdN’s 3,000 employees ensure that it fulfills its mission: to excel as an integrated provider of maritime links.  
 

Are you looking for the next step in your payroll career?
 

Are you an experienced payroll professional who enjoys working in an international environment, thrives on accuracy and compliance, and likes to take ownership? Then this role may be the perfect next step in your career.
 

Your role
 
 

• As Senior Payroll Officer, you support the Payroll Lead in ensuring accurate, timely and compliant payroll operations across the continent countries where CLdN operates. 

• You play a key role in the execution, control and continuous improvement of payroll processes. Working closely with the Payroll Lead, you independently manage end-to-end payroll activities for assigned countries and can take ownership of international payroll operations when required. 

Your profile
 
 

•   Minimum 5 years of payroll experience, preferably in an international or multi-country environment.  

• Solid understanding of payroll operations, tax legislation, social security regulations and labour law requirements.  

• Proven ability to independently manage payroll processes and complex payroll cases.  

• Experience working with external payroll providers and HRIS/payroll systems.  

• Strong analytical skills and a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.  

• Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines and stakeholders across different countries.  

• Proactive, reliable and solution-oriented mindset.  

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.  

• Fluent in English; additional languages are considered an asset.

For one of our clients, a company specialising in the petrochemical sector and located in the centre of Brussels, we are looking for a Customer Service Officer.

In general he/she is the interface for the different services within the organization and will specialized for commercial and marketing topics.

Your responsibilities as a Customer Service Officer :

Customers :* Handle requests and claims from customers by phone and by email;* Contracts & files : check input, rebates & additional services contracts;* Follow-up marketing actions decided by the Benelux Country Manager;* Order of new customer cards and toll box;* Follow-up portfolio of customers;* Help train the customers to use autonomously extranet, customer portal etc.

General administration :* Mails (post) and the e-mails on the general mailbox;* Sales support for the sales representatives : invoice, edit credit notes, etc;* Reporting activities;* Back-up of colleagues (customer service, sales officer).

Network :* Administrative help to Technical Manager;* Manual acceptance authorization;* Follow up of fraud cases in stations;* Resolve and help customers on issues related to cards and tolls.

The ideal profile of a Customer Service Officer :* You have a perfect command of Dutch, both spoken and written. You also have a very good knowledge of French, both spoken and written. Knowledge of English is an asset.* You have initial experience in Customer Service, Customer Care or file management.* You have a good knowledge of IT tools (MS Office) and are familiar with CRM systems.* You are an organised person, you are willing to take initiative and you have good customer relations skills.* You can easily switch between different tasks and have strong communication skills.

For our client, a global leader in roll-on/roll-off cargo handling and storage, we are looking for a motivated Pre-Delivery Inspection Operator.

As a Pre-Delivery Inspection Operator, you ensure that every vehicle leaves the premises in top condition. You carry out inspections, prepare vehicles for delivery and make sure any defects or damage are identified and reported correctly.

Preparation and inspection

 
• 
You drive the vehicles through the car wash.

 
• 
You check that all functions are working properly, including the radio and battery.

You inspect the tires.

 
• 
You carry out a thorough inspection to identify any damage.

 
• 
You mark any detected damage for the repair department.

Finishing and preparing for delivery

 
• 
You check and confirm the license plates.

 
• 
You equip the vehicles with a fire extinguisher, warning triangle and manuals.

 
• 
You vacuum and clean the vehicle interiors.

Other tasks

 
• 
You move vehicles to the correct zones on the premises.

 
• 
You report defects or deviations to the responsible person in a timely manner.

 
• 
You upload software updates.

What we expect from you

 
• 
You speak Dutch and/or English well enough to communicate fluently with your colleagues.

 
• 
You have a valid driving license and can drive both manual and automatic vehicles.

 
• 
You have the technical insight needed to identify and assess damage.

At 
World of Tents in Ronse, we design, develop and supply shelter solutions and crisis response equipment for organisations operating in some of the world's most demanding environments.
 

Our brands 
ALPINTER and SHIELD, support humanitarian organisations, governments, defence and emergency response teams with reliable products designed to perform when it matters most. To strengthen our Quality team, we are looking for a QHSE Specialist who combines an eye for detail with a hands-on mindset and a passion for continuous improvement in product and performance.
 

WHAT WILL YOU DO? 
As our Quality Management Officer, you contribute to the appropriate quality and reliability of our products, from raw materials to finished solutions. Working closely with our QHSE Manager, WOT Teams, international suppliers and external specialist stakeholders, you combine 
quality management processes, QA/QC coordination with our manufacturing partners and product testing, in a practical & problem-solving manner.
 

Here's where you will make a difference:
 

1. Quality Management & compliance
 
 

• Maintain and improve our Quality Management Systems (QMS), supporting ISO 9001 & 14001 compliance, internal & external audits and QA/QC procedures. 

• Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, product quality and sustainability. 

• Support Product Development and Supply Chain colleagues in Quality related aspects of their work  

2. Product Quality & Testing
 
 

• Define quality requirements and testing procedures for raw materials and finished products,  

• Coordinate product testing for core items such as tents, core relief items and other shelter-related equipment, together with internal teams and external laboratories. 

• Analyse test results, identify risks and translate findings into practical improvements.  

3. Customer & Supplier Quality
 
 

• Ensure our products meet customer specifications and quality expectations. 

• Investigate quality complaints, identify root causes and coordinate corrective actions with the teams involved. 

• Monitor incoming goods and supplier quality, following up on inspection reports and quality issues.  

4. Processes & Sustainability
 
 

• Develop, review and audit standard operating procedures and production controls. 

• Identify opportunities to improve process efficiency, consistency and sustainability in collaboration with the QHSE Manager.  

You work closely with our Quality Officer, who provides practical support during product inspections and testing, and report directly to the QHSE Manager.
 

READY TO MAKE YOUR QUALITIES COUNT?
 

We'd love to hear from you! Send your CV to jobs@wot.group.

WHAT QUALITIES ARE WE LOOKING FOR?
 

We are looking for someone who combines 
technical knowledge with a practical, solution-oriented approach.
 
 

• A degree in Textile Technology, Quality Management, Engineering or a related technical field, or min 3 years of equivalent experience. 

• Experience in respect to quality control processes; experience with ISO 9001/14001 or Quality Management Systems is a plus. 

• Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and the ability to turn findings into clear reports and improvements. 

• Comfortable working with MS Office and Data Management systems 

• Fluent in English; Dutch and/or French are an advantage. 

• Experience with textiles, technical fabrics and/or product testing is a plus.  

And just as importantly, you:
 
 

• Are analytical, accurate and looking for solutions 

• Enjoy hands-on work and practical result driven approach 

• Take ownership and work independently. 

• Communicate easily and enjoy collaborating with different teams. 

• Are curious, proactive and eager to learn.
